# semaphore_ex_totp_policy (Resource)

Configures the global TOTP enrollment policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_totp_policy" "organization" {
  state             = "required_selected"
  selected_user_ids = [42]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `state` (String)

### Optional

- `selected_user_ids` (List of Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
